# ModalTitle

```ts
import { ModalTitle } from '@cake-admin/cakeand';
```

Modal Title is the header region of a modal dialog. It presents the dialog's primary heading, optional supporting text, an optional leading icon, and a close action. Use it inside a Radix Dialog content surface; use a page heading instead when the content is not a transient modal.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `React.ReactNode` | **required** | Visible dialog heading, rendered through Radix Dialog.Title. |
| `subtitle` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Optional supporting text, rendered through Radix Dialog.Description. |
| `modalIcon` | `ModalIconType` | — | Optional semantic leading treatment. ModalTitle exclusively composes ModalIcon for this slot. |
| `modalIconSlot` | `React.ReactNode` | — | Optional custom glyph used only with modalIcon="icon". |
| `onClose` | `React.MouseEventHandler<HTMLButtonElement>` | — | Fired when the reusable close icon button is activated. The consumer owns Dialog open state and should set it to false here. |
| `closeLabel` | `string` | `'Close dialog'` | Accessible name for the optional close control. |

Also accepts all `Omit<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'title'>` props.

## Usage

```tsx
<ModalTitle title="Title" />
<ModalTitle title="Title" subtitle="Subtitle" />
<ModalTitle title="Team members" modalIcon="success" />
<ModalTitle title="Settings" onClose={() => setOpen(false)} />
<ModalTitle title="Preferences" subtitle="Configure your experience" modalIcon="icon" modalIconSlot={<PanelsTopLeft />} onClose={close} />
```

`--color-surfaces-container`, `--space-300`, `--space-500`, `--space-100`, `--color-text-icon-primary`, `--font-weight-medium`, `--type-size-subtitle`, `--color-text-icon-secondary`, `--font-weight-regular`, `--type-size-body`, `--space-050`

## Accessibility

- Radix Dialog.Title and Dialog.Description provide the heading and description semantics consumed by the owning Dialog.
- The close action is the existing IconButton, which uses Radix AccessibleIcon to announce its closeLabel.
- The close control retains the shared IconButton keyboard focus ring.
- Keep the title concise; long text truncates to preserve the header layout.

## Do / Don't

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Use a concise title that describes the dialog's task. | Use a page heading as a modal title. |
| Provide a subtitle only when it adds useful context. | Repeat the title in the subtitle. |
| Wire onClose to the owning Dialog state. | Treat this header as the component that owns dialog state. |
| Use a familiar leading glyph to reinforce the dialog context. | Add multiple competing actions to the header. |
